def test_sort_array():
    # Empty array returns empty list
    assert sort_array([]) == []

    # Single-element arrays
    assert sort_array([5]) == [5]   # 5+5=10 (even) -> descending
    assert sort_array([0]) == [0]   # 0+0=0 (even) -> descending

    # First + last is odd -> ascending order
    assert sort_array([2, 4, 3, 0, 1, 5]) == [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]   # 2+5=7
    assert sort_array([2, 1]) == [1, 2]                            # 2+1=3
    assert sort_array([1, 2, 3, 4]) == [1, 2, 3, 4]                # 1+4=5
    assert sort_array([-1, -3, -5, 2]) == [-5, -3, -1, 2]          # -1+2=1

    # First + last is even -> descending order
    assert sort_array([2, 4, 3, 0, 1, 5, 6]) == [6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0]  # 2+6=8
    assert sort_array([1, 2, 3]) == [3, 2, 1]                          # 1+3=4
    assert sort_array([5, 3, 1]) == [5, 3, 1]                          # 5+1=6
    assert sort_array([3, 1, 2, 3]) == [3, 3, 2, 1]                    # 3+3=6
    assert sort_array([-2, -3, -4]) == [-2, -3, -4]                    # -2+-4=-6

    original = [3, 1, 2]
    sort_array(original)  # 3+2=5 (odd) -> ascending
    assert original == [3, 1, 2]

    assert sort_array([2, 4, 3, 0]) == [4, 3, 2, 0]      # 2+0=2 (even)

    assert sort_array([1, 3]) == [3, 1]                  # 1+3=4 (even)
